task: Rewrite all Star Bazaar events (EN and RU) as short stories that react to skills
open_questions: Pool events EV01-EV28 and EV40-EV51 have no Russian in the game: tools/build_story.py scope rejects EV<nn> ids and EV01-EV28 text sits in data/events.json. Widen scope and serve by id?
Skill-gated options (story/gated_options.md) need the owner's yes, then economy numbers and a gate in code. Which steps first?
EV42, EV44, EV45, EV47, EV48, EV49, EV50, EV51 texts now follow data/chains.json planets and goods (the old text named Quillon and Brannock). OK to keep?
handoff: All 28 chain steps (mil, lux, min, bio) and every live pool event are rewritten: TITLE, BODY, button names kept, RES and RES_TITLE as stories; EFF and STD lines untouched, ids and placeholders unchanged. English is in story/screens.md and story/events.md, Russian in story/ru/events_*.json; build_story.py and the headless tests pass (1204 PASS, 0 FAIL). Russian for pool events is staged in story/ru/pool_events.md, not built. Skill-gated options are a spec only: story/gated_options.md, 31 rows with EN and RU buttons. Next: owner decision, economy numbers, programmer gate. Unchanged: EV19 nomads, BE01-BE03, button texts, STD rival lines.
